reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that integrates the locally authenticated Codex App Server as a selectable main-model provider, with tool bridging, image handling, and optional web-search takeover.

summaries.zh: 将本地登录的 Codex App Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为可选择的主模型提供方，并桥接工具、图像和可选的网页搜索能力。
summaries.en: Connects a locally authenticated Codex App Server to DeepSeek Harness as a selectable main-model provider with tool bridging, image handling, and optional web-search takeover.

capabilities: Registers a Codex App Server-backed language-model provider for DeepSeek Harness
Launches and manages local Codex App Server processes using the local Codex account state
Transmits conversation context, tool requests, and image data to the Codex App Server
Exposes validated Harness tool calls and optionally intercepts Codex-agent web searches
Supports native image generation and converts image inputs and outputs between Harness and Codex formats
